brainlife.desc: FGATIR (fast gray matter acquisition T1 inversion recovery) anatomical NIfTI: T1-weighted with suppressed white matter, used for deep nuclei.
brainlife.name: neuro/fgtair

original.desc: Fast Gray Matter Acquisition T1 Inversion Recovery (FGATIR) sequence. T1 with opposite contrast

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Visualising and delineating deep grey nuclei (e.g. for DBS targeting).

**Not for:** Apps expecting a standard T1w contrast. Sharing outside a controlled project without defacing.

**BIDS:** anat/T1w (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.fgtair.json
